raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 주말 식물 마켓을 홍보해줘. SNS에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 각각 전체 스타일과 레이아웃이 달랐으면 좋겠어. 식물을 고르고 집에서 돌보는 즐거움이 느껴지도록 만들고, 긴 설명과 방문 안내가 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 작은 이미지나 질감을 붙이는 단색 템플릿은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 다음 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

집 안의 작은 숲
LEAVES & LIVING
초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.
작은 화분부터 오래 키운 나무까지 만납니다. 재배자의 이야기를 듣고, 우리 집의 빛과 생활에 맞는 식물을 골라보세요.
성수 주말 식물 마켓
2027.06.12–06.13
토·일 11:00–19:00
성수 온실마당
입장 무료 · 분갈이 시연
식물 구매 시 관리 안내 제공
편하게 들러 천천히 둘러보세요.

compact_recording.execution: Inside the same fresh critic session before immutable CLI completion; no post-completion export

procedure.method: Independent fresh-session pixel review using functions.exec and tools.view_image with detail original; each result was emitted and visually inspected. Read the literal packet/case, rules, rubric, compact method/addendum and pinned adapter; verified pinned file bytes and PNG header dimensions. Read the five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded producer/source paths. The packet contains no source assets or protected-layout manifests, so no source opens or protected-layout reads were available or claimed. Actually opened M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2 in that order, then M3, M4 and M5 in that order: all fifteen poster views preceded the first copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment or score. After retaining all first raw readings, made one exact native ambiguity revisit of M1 for date/hours range separators, M2 for headline word space and M4 for headline word space. No further revisit, crop, replacement asset or image editing was performed. All native views were 1672×941, usage views 720×405 and thumbnails 320×180. Native 16:9 correctness uses the pinned nearest-integer-single-edge policy at a 0.5 px height deviation; reduced views preserve aspect within the declared integer rounding. No runtime session identity or additional tool-open identifier is invented.

issues: The literal requirement for five distinct whole visual systems is not met: M3 and M4 reuse a central event/title/brand/tagline/five-line paragraph sequence and a lower two-column visit block, with large botanical side imagery. Replacing framed illustration with process photography and changing title type does not change that reading scaffold enough.

evidence.location: whole flat landscape poster
evidence.observation: One opaque landscape design combines a large left-hand photograph of a person holding a planted pot with three upper detail photographs. The achieved style is photographic editorial collage; open style imposes no tape texture or medium restriction.

evidence.location: left photograph and upper detail strip
evidence.observation: Hands cradle a living pothos among other pots; close views show a leaf, potting substrate and trailing foliage. These substantive images communicate selection, touch and attentive plant care rather than a small ornament on a passive information field.

evidence.location: right narrative and lower information rows
evidence.observation: The explanation is readable in three lines; date/place/care form the left lower column and hours/access the right. Invitation and intact URL sit along the bottom. All twelve printed entries appear once; no logo, QR, watermark or additional copy is visible.

evidence.location: whole composition relative to M3 and M4

evidence.location: whole flat landscape poster
evidence.observation: One opaque landscape design combines a large left-hand photograph of a person holding a planted pot with three upper detail photographs. The achieved style is photographic editorial collage; open style imposes no tape texture or medium restriction.

evidence.location: left photograph and upper detail strip
evidence.observation: Hands cradle a living pothos among other pots; close views show a leaf, potting substrate and trailing foliage. These substantive images communicate selection, touch and attentive plant care rather than a small ornament on a passive information field.

evidence.location: right narrative and lower information rows
evidence.observation: The explanation is readable in three lines; date/place/care form the left lower column and hours/access the right. Invitation and intact URL sit along the bottom. All twelve printed entries appear once; no logo, QR, watermark or additional copy is visible.

evidence.location: whole composition relative to M3 and M4
evidence.observation: The full-height left photograph and upper contact strip give M1 a clear route of its own. The complete set still contains the closely repeated central text/side imagery scaffold in M3 and M4, so the collective five-system condition fails.

style.checked_requirement:
덕테이프 포스터로 주말 식물 마켓을 홍보해줘. SNS에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 각각 전체 스타일과 레이아웃이 달랐으면 좋겠어. 식물을 고르고 집에서 돌보는 즐거움이 느껴지도록 만들고, 긴 설명과 방문 안내가 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 작은 이미지나 질감을 붙이는 단색 템플릿은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 다음 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

Each copy entry once with exact Korean/Latin/numbers/punctuation and meaningful word spaces. No extra print, logo, watermark or QR.
Five independent single flat opaque landscape16:9 posters, not mockups or a comparison sheet.
Five genuinely distinct whole visual systems in spatial organization, image editing, type roles and reading routes, not different media over a common scaffold.

procedure.method: Independent review in this fresh session with session_id unobservable and therefore null. Verified all 33 explicitly pinned file hashes/byte counts and exact PNG dimensions. Read the pinned case, packet, rules, rubric, recording addendum/method/adapter and all five supplied native-evidence manifests before viewing; no embedded producer paths or peer records were opened. The packet supplies no source assets or protected layouts, so their receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Actually opened every exact poster image with tools.view_image(detail:original) and emitted it for visual inspection, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same three-view order. All fifteen original poster opens preceded the first copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment or score. Recorded 60 first raw readings from the viewed pixels, keeping soft wraps. One subsequent exact M1 native open was the single ambiguity-triggered revisit for its date and hours entries; neither separator class was resolved. No image edits, alternate crops/assets, generation, spawning, forking, resuming or session/event IDs were invented. Native dimensions are 1672×941; each ratio passes by abs(941−1672×9/16)=0.5 pixel, not exact equality. Usage views are 720×405, thumbnails 320×180, within their specified bounds with normal integer rounding.

procedure.method: Independent fresh critique using only the explicitly pinned inputs. Read the full packet/case, rubric/rules, compact method/addendum/adapter and the five exact pinned native-evidence manifests; did not follow embedded producer paths. Verified all supplied input and image/manifest SHA-256/byte pins and native/view PNG dimensions. The packet declares no source assets or protected layouts, so both receipts arrays are explicitly empty. With functions.exec and tools.view_image(detail:'original'), actually opened and visually examined M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; then M2 in that order; then M3; then M4; then M5: all fifteen initial poster views preceded the first text-reading/transcription, judgment or score. Retained actual first pixel readings for all twelve entries of all five members. Only then reopened the exact M1 native asset once to revisit its date/hour dash-class ambiguities; both remain unresolved, and both first readings remain unchanged. No OCR, crop, replacement asset, generation, peer/producer review, spawn, fork, resume or invented event/session identity was used. Native headers and RGB pixel inspection confirm 1672x941 opaque posters; 941 is 0.5 pixel from width-derived 940.5, so ratio PASS uses the predeclared nearest-integer-single-edge tolerance, not mathematical exactness. Pinned use views are 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180, with rounded downsampling and no upsampling.

emotion_control.location: held plant and warm sunlit background

ai_slop.location: hands, pot construction and image/text boundaries

content_form.location: middle shelf from broad-leaved plant to hand-held trailing plant

hierarchy.location: upper-left headline and two-line explanation beneath the shelf
hierarchy.observation: The title is highly prominent, but the long explanation is also very heavy and almost spans the full width. The bold slogan, explanation and logistics compete for emphasis rather than forming a finely resolved supporting sequence.

hierarchy.location: top type and lower text band
hierarchy.observation: Both text bands read as dense dark blocks around the shelf, so the information architecture feels more functional than specifically refined.

typography.observation: The explanation uses a large bold sans-serif weight close to the emphatic headline and slogan language, leaving little tonal differentiation for sustained reading. The long second line is an especially heavy continuous strip.
Glyphs and word spaces remain readable and faithful, but the predominantly bold type makes the supporting copy visually blunt and less comfortable than its content length warrants.

space.location: shelf baseline and surrounding text margins
space.observation: The plants share a coherent horizontal shelf with convincing pot footprints; the title/date fields sit above it and the explanatory/footer fields below. Side crops make the row feel continuous, and the text stays clear of the foliage.

image_material.location: plant silhouettes, pots and right-hand grip
image_material.observation: The drawn leaf species differ visibly, terracotta/ochre/green pot surfaces remain coherent, and the shelf shadows seat the pots. The right hand supports the pot in a readable gesture, consistent with the illustrated construction.

emotion_control.location: green plant assortment against warm pale background
emotion_control.observation: The lively assortment and warm shelf create an accessible weekend-market invitation. The hand gesture adds friendliness without turning the image into a decorative mascot.

ai_slop.location: shelf, plant stems and hand at right
ai_slop.observation: The plants have identifiable individual forms, pots sit on the shelf, and overlaps remain understandable. No arbitrary icons, duplicated print or contradictory objects are visible; cropped edge plants are deliberate continuations of the display.

residuals: The very heavy two-line explanation competes with title and slogan; hierarchy and typography remain functional rather than fully refined.

image_material.location: variegated leaves, soil, pot rims and floor shadows

emotion_control.location: warm light and intimate overhead view

content_form.location: paired root-ball and potting-medium crops

hierarchy.location: left root image, central headline and right pot image

space.location: bottom information and image-panel junctions

image_material.location: root texture, supporting hand and right pot rim

emotion_control.location: hands and living plant in monochrome

ai_slop.location: root ball, hands, pot contact and photograph seams

evidence.location: central and lower-left foliage and pots
evidence.observation: Large leafy potted plants occupy most of the image field and stay recognizable; they are substantive nonglyph content rather than small ornaments.

evidence.location: overhead pots in sunlight with leaf shadows
evidence.observation: The plants, soil and sunlit domestic surface give the joy of arranging and growing plants at home a tangible setting, particularly the supplied concern with a home's light. The image supports selection through several different potted leaf forms without inventing a person or an invisible action.

content_form.location: diagonal overhead arrangement and cast leaf shadows
content_form.observation: Several distinct pots and leaf forms arranged in warm household light communicate an indoor collection and its care context. The light/shadow relationship is specifically relevant to choosing a plant for a home's conditions.

hierarchy.location: left two-line title, central plants and right copy stack
hierarchy.observation: The title attracts attention on the left, the overhead plants carry the image, and the right value/explanation/visit stack provides a clear second route. The information is grouped in one column rather than dispersed.

hierarchy.location: headline and plant diagonal
hierarchy.observation: The headline remains recognizable and the large foliage creates a clear visual path between title and right text area.

typography.location: burgundy serif title and right-column practical copy
typography.observation: The two-line serif title has coherent proportions and a word-boundary break; the Latin name is separate and the supporting sans-serif uses clear weights. Hangul, dates and URL remain intact.

typography.location: five-line explanation and final information lines
typography.observation: The full right column stays readable with adequate line separation, visible punctuation and an unbroken URL.

space.location: left title clearing, central pots and right sunlit opening
space.observation: The diagonal plant arrangement creates intentional clearings for headline and information. Cropped large leaves establish scale at the lower left, while the right column keeps consistent margins and enough room for the complete copy.

image_material.location: variegated leaves, soil, pot rims and floor shadows
image_material.observation: Painterly strokes are consistent across foliage, terracotta, soil and the sunlit surface. Different leaf patterns and the readable top-down pot openings retain subject specificity, and shadows belong to the surrounding plants.

emotion_control.location: warm light and intimate overhead view
emotion_control.observation: The close, sunlit collection conveys a gentle pleasure in living with plants. The burgundy headline and natural greens are expressive without overpowering the practical invitation.

ai_slop.observation: Leaf clusters belong to identifiable pots, variegation follows leaf forms, and the broad shadows remain coherent with the scene. No arbitrary motifs, pseudo-objects or decorative text are visible.

residuals: The painterly overhead arrangement is the clearest domestic-light concept in the set, but it does not depict a grower conversation or an actual selection action; those are communicated by the words.

evidence.observation: Oversized illustrated pots produce an enclosing botanical route, distinct in crop and editing from M2. The title/Latin/value/body and two-column visit-information base remain close to M4's central text route, while the green/cream palette and serif title relate to M1.

evidence.location: left tall photo, upper-right photo and pale central type field
evidence.observation: The exposed roots make the subject specifically about care, but the left-photo/pale-copy/additional-photo scaffold is a close relative of M1. Its centered title/body and lower split logistics also relate to M3; monochrome material and a gothic title do not by themselves create a wholly separate system.

evidence.location: left two-line title, overhead diagonal plants and right copy column

residuals: The set contains meaningful differences in plant viewpoint, crop, image construction and some reading routes; the score is not inferred from material names.
